messages:
Lena: Quick sync Starting a light-weight migration: standardize snippet param names and short captions. Proposal: client param `result` -> `response` in snippets, use `model_version` in code samples, and prefer the glossary term 'prefetch' instead of 'cache warming'. Will open tiny PRs for py/js/go.

Omar: OK. Can we also add a parenthetical under each snippet clarifying "response is the client param, not the raw API response"? That helped users previously.

Priya: Agree on the parenthetical. Also please ensure code fences include language tags (```python, ```js). MDX playground fails otherwise.

Ben: Note from infra: do not change API schema names in docs. We had a near-miss where someone tried to rename `choices` in examples. Only change example variable names.

Lena: Good catch. PR description will state: "examples-only rename; no API contract changes."

docs-bot: Link-checker: 4 broken links found in /docs/samples; see report in #eng-docs. Glossary v2: preferred term is "prefetch".

Omar: I'll handle JS + test harness. Priya, can you sanity-check the Python snippet?

Priya: Yes. Also quick voice note: UI copy should read "model version" (two words) while code uses `model_version`. Use active verbs in captions ("Fetch the embedding" vs "Getting embeddings").

Lena: Labels for each PR: `docs:migration`, `needs-glossary-review`, `needs-voice-approval`. Approvers: Priya (voice), Lena (author), +1 eng. Target: 5 business day review.

Ben: Ill run the linter over the branches and flag any MDX errors.

Lena: Opening PRs now and will ping here when they're ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4305 (py), /pull/4306 (js), /pull/4307 (go).

Omar: Thanks 680 will review tonight.

Priya: Reviewing after lunch.

Lena: Thanks team 4AA
